title: Piggly Wiggly Grocery Store, 537-541 Salem Avenue, Dayton, Montgomery County, OH
notes: Significance: This building is significant for its contribution to the commercial development of the Steele's Hill-Grafton Hill Historic District; a district which was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1986. The district is composed mainly of late nineteenth and early twentieth century residential buildings expressed with a mix of architectural styles. For a description of the Steele's Hill-Grafton Hill Historic District, refer to HABS No. OH-2467.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 86001237
